# Test fixtures — vendored, not generated

These files let `cargo test --workspace --lib` run in a clean checkout
(GitHub Actions) instead of silently skipping tests that used to read
them from a sibling WordPress copy / v1 repo on the author's machine
(`~/workspace/wordless/reference/wordpress-7.1.5/` and
`~/workspace/wordless/wordless-cms/`).

## Provenance

- `wordpress/hello.php` — Hello Dolly 1.7.2, WordPress core plugin,
  WordPress 7.1.5 release (GPLv2 or later, as in its file header).
- `wordpress/twentytwentyfive/` — Twenty Twenty-Five theme, PHP files
  only (99 files; the theme's fonts/images/JSON are not needed — the
  tests only read `.php`), WordPress 7.1.5 release (GPLv2 or later).
  `wordpress/twentytwentyfive/functions.php` is the same file.
- `wordless/hello-dolly-index.ts` — converted Hello Dolly output,
  generated by the Wordless v1 conversion engine (Milestone 4) from
  hello.php; byte-for-byte copy of
  `ola1de/Wordless-CMS:examples/hello-dolly/index.ts`. The
  byte-for-byte converter test compares against this file.

Do not edit these by hand. To refresh the WordPress files, re-fetch
them from the matching WordPress release tag.
